prompt: Zoom into China markets this week — finance news, market outlook, sources please
expected_output: Region-zoom report focused on China + HK, using Caixin/SCMP/PBoC sources, all sections present

assertions.name: scope_declared_as_china
assertions.description: Output must declare scope as China (or China + HK) at the top
assertions.check: output contains 'Scope:' or '**Scope' and ('China' or 'CN' or 'Greater China')

assertions.name: uses_china_specific_sources
assertions.description: Output must reference China-specific sources (Caixin, SCMP, PBoC, NBS, CSRC)
assertions.check: output contains at least 2 of: Caixin, scmp.com, PBoC, pbc.gov.cn, stats.gov.cn, NBS, CSRC, NDRC, Nikkei Asia

assertions.name: covers_chinese_assets
assertions.description: Output must cover Chinese equities and at least 1 of: yuan (USD/CNY), Hang Seng, Shanghai Composite, CSI 300
assertions.check: output contains ('Hang Seng' or 'HSI' or 'Shanghai' or 'SHCOMP' or 'CSI 300' or 'A-shares' or 'H-shares' or 'KWEB' or 'BABA' or 'JD' or 'PDD' or 'TCEHY') AND ('yuan' or 'CNY' or 'USD/CNY' or 'PBOC' or 'LPR' or 'PBoC')

assertions.name: all_main_sections_present
assertions.description: Output must contain Market Overview + at least 2 of the 5 sections (A-E)
assertions.check: output contains 'Market Overview' AND at least 2 of: 'Value', 'Momentum', 'Allocation', 'Options', 'Trends' or 'Risks'

assertions.name: disclaimer_present
assertions.description: Output must include the mandatory disclaimer
assertions.check: output contains '**Disclaimer:**' and 'not constitute financial advice'
